results.text: Pharmacokinetics of nifedipine. The pharmacokinetics of a slow-release formulation of nifedipine were studied following oral administration of a single 20 mg tablet in nine young male volunteers. Blood samples were collected and nifedipine concentrations analysed by gas liquid chromatography. Compared to conventional nifedipine, there was a delay in peak concentrations and a much smaller range of peak plasma levels.
